evidence_summary: In ambulatory nursing-home residents aged >=80 years, the study evaluated the World Guidelines gait-speed threshold of <=0.8 m/s for fall-risk stratification. Slower gait speed was associated with a greater likelihood of past-year fall history, but interpretation is limited to the relatively high-functioning independently ambulatory institutional population studied.
